en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a narrow, gently curving street in a historic European town. On both sides are plastered houses with steep tiled roofs; one façade is patterned with dark and light triangles, and further back stand larger gabled buildings and a small tower-like structure. In the background a church with a tall, slender baroque-style spire rises above the rooftops. Townspeople in early 20th‑century clothing—men in hats and coats, women in long skirts, and children—stand or walk along the street and by a stone retaining wall with steps. Trees overhang parts of the scene, and there are no motor vehicles visible.
